Strengthening Indigenous Resilience Through Clean Energy

By providing reliable access to clean energy, this project will help the people of Barangay Dulao remain on their ancestral lands, preserve their cultural heritage, and protect the vital watersheds and forests that sustain their community. It also offers a model for climate-adaptive solutions, demonstrating how renewable energy can strengthen Indigenous resilience while helping other remote communities overcome the challenges of aging micro-hydro systems.
